name: GitHub
description: Connect GitHub so Habibi can read your profile and recent public repositories when you ask.

presentation.fallback:
GitHub
Your profile and public projects, ready to talk about with Habibi.
Read your GitHub profile and list 10 recently updated public repositories you own. No private repositories, file contents or write access.

tools.name: github_get_profile
tools.description: Read the connected GitHub account's profile. Requires the user to connect the bundled GitHub Kit. Results are shared with this conversation; credentials are never returned.

tools.name: github_list_repositories
tools.description: List up to ten recently updated public repositories owned by the connected GitHub account. Does not read private repositories or repository contents. Results are shared with this conversation; credentials are never returned.
